what: surface.thicken of a revolved sheet with two holes trimmed into it (a bottle's wall where a handle joins): truck panics with 'This wire is not simple', reported as a kernel internal error (with one hole the thicken gives two bodies and a shell that is not closed)
method: the bottle sheet of 195-blend-from-a-hole-trimmed-in-a-revolved-sheet with radius-7 holes at z = 25 and z = 75, thickened 2 mm inwards: the profile's smallest radius of curvature is far larger than 2 mm, so the wall is one closed, valid solid; its volume is the thickened sheet's own (no closed form for the spline profile), so only the outcome and validity are graded. Thicken keeps the sheet it thickens, so the recipe removes the sheet afterwards (as 194-thicken-five-sided-patch does) and the one body graded is the thickened solid.
